request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: The query counts public symbols of each kind (class, function, method) from the code.symbols table, excluding any files that are test files. A symbol is public when is_public is TRUE, which means neither its name nor its enclosing class name starts with an underscore, thus excluding dunder methods and underscore-prefixed classes/methods. Nested functions and classes are not separately represented in symbols, so they are not counted. The result is one row per kind with the total public count in non-test code.
sql:
SELECT 'class' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND is_public = TRUE AND file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'function' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'function' AND is_public = TRUE AND file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'method' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'method' AND is_public = TRUE AND file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE)
